plan.rationale: An NPO with a clear mission and five distinct program areas needs room to explain the need before asking for support. Deep forest and editorial serif read as grounded and serious rather than corporate. Pillars carry the program areas, a deep band carries the founding belief, featureSplit gives the partnership pitch its own weight, and process explains how someone actually gets involved. No photos exist yet so slots are requested where they would carry real weight.

sections.headline: Building pathways to opportunity, safety and hope
sections.subheadline: The Seven Passes Initiative works at grassroots level in the Hoekwil and Touwsranten communities on the Garden Route, tackling the root causes of violence and poverty before they take hold.

sections.heading: We do not provide handouts. We create pathways.
paragraphs: Hoekwil and Touwsranten face high unemployment, limited access to quality education, and family violence that repeats across generations. Our model is holistic, practical and community driven. We intervene before violence escalates, rather than reacting once harm is done.

Every child deserves a future free from fear. Every family deserves the tools to thrive. Every community deserves to grow with dignity and purpose. We are building that future, one life, one household, one program at a time.

items.title: Youth Empowerment
items.body: After school programs, academic support and youth leadership development.

items.title: Educational Enrichment
items.body: Partnering with local schools to improve learning outcomes and infrastructure.

items.title: Family Support
items.body: Parenting workshops, trauma informed care, counselling and home visits.

items.title: Violence Prevention
items.body: Early intervention programs, community dialogues, mentorship and awareness campaigns.

items.title: Community Collaboration
items.body: Building networks with local authorities, businesses and stakeholders to amplify change.

sections.heading: Why partner with us
sections.body: Partnering with Seven Passes is not about ticking a CSR checkbox, it is about directing real resources to the people and places that need it most. As a sponsor or corporate partner you gain visibility among a socially conscious audience, align your brand with purpose driven development, and access storytelling opportunities to showcase your impact in action. Whether you are a local enterprise or a national brand, your involvement signals commitment to a stronger South Africa.
